title: A few VC firms are poised to win the future
excerpt: In 2022, two events profoundly reordered the venture capital landscape. The Fed began a hiking cycle that would take rates from near zero to over 5%, crateri...
content_html:
James Thorne, Stephanie Zhu

Thu, July 30, 2026 at 2:00 AM PDT 1 min read

In 2022, two events profoundly reordered the venture capital landscape. The Fed began a hiking cycle that would take rates from near zero to over 5%, cratering private tech valuations and shutting off the IPO market. Then, OpenAI released ChatGPT, kicking off a global scramble to fund the future of AI.

The story since then has been one of concentration. A small number of AI companies absorbed vast amounts of venture capital and reached valuations that were once unfathomable in private markets. The number of VC firms shrank, but some grew ever larger and came to dominate the startup market.

If AI proves to be the seismic technological shift many believe it to be, those leading VC firms now have an opportunity to reap vast profits in the coming years.

*The top 30 VC firms were selected based on their investment track record. A full methodology can be found in our Emerging Tech Indicator report.

This article originally appeared on PitchBook News

content_html_zh:
詹姆斯·索恩、斯蒂芬妮·朱

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 30 日星期四凌晨 2:00 阅读 1 分钟

2022 年，有两件事深刻地改变了风险投资格局。 美联储开始了加息周期，将利率从接近于零的水平提高到超过 5%，导致私营科技公司的估值大幅下跌，并导致 IPO 市场关闭。 随后，OpenAI 发布了 ChatGPT，拉开了全球为人工智能未来融资的热潮。

从那时起，故事就变成了一个专注的故事。 少数人工智能公司吸收了大量风险投资，并达到了曾经在私募市场上难以估量的估值。 风险投资公司的数量有所减少，但其中一些公司的规模却不断扩大，并逐渐主导了创业市场。

如果人工智能被证明是许多人所认为的重大技术变革，那么那些领先的风险投资公司现在有机会在未来几年获得巨额利润。

*前 30 名风险投资公司是根据其投资记录选出的。 完整的方法可以在我们的新兴技术指标报告中找到。
